Confirmed matches (skeleton + CID, correct L-stereochemistry, high confidence): id113 alpha-ketoglutaric acid = 2-Oxoglutaric acid (KPGXRSRHYNQIFN, CID 51); id9 Asparagine = L-Asparagine (DCXYFEDJOCDNAF, CID 6267); id22 Histidine = L-Histidine (HNDVDQJCIGZPNO, CID 6274); id42 Serine = L-Serine (MTCFGRXMJLQNBG, CID 5951); id151 Glutamine = L-Glutamine (ZDXPYRJPNDTMRX-VKHMYHEASA-N, CID 5961); id26 'L-Glutamate' and id27 'L-Glutamic acid' both full-InChIKey-identical to member L-Glutamic acid (WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-VKHMYHEASA-N, CID 33032). Lower-confidence judgement calls included for recall: id18 'DL-Glutamic acid' (same skeleton WHUUTDBJXJRKMK, racemate, CID 611) contains the L-glutamate member -> stereo/parent, medium; id60 L-Pyroglutamic acid/5-oxoproline (ODHCTXKNWHHXJC, CID 7405) is the spontaneous intramolecular lactam (dehydrated cyclized form) of L-glutamate/L-glutamine, an obvious parent-derivative -> stereo/parent, low. Members NOT detected in the 388: Ammonia, Carbamoyl phosphate, CO2, Water, Phosphate/Phosphoric acid, Pyruvic acid, NAD+/NADH, ATP/ADP/AMP, Lipoic acid, Dihydrolipoic acid, S-aminomethyldihydrolipoamide, 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate, tetrahydrofolate, pyrophosphate, urocanic acid, Glycine (only glycine conjugates like isovalerylglycine id289/suberylglycine id193 present -- distinct molecules, not free glycine, excluded), and free L-Aspartic acid (CKLJMWTZIZZHCS not present; id9 is asparagine, a distinct compound). Glutamate/glutamine-carrying conjugates (e.g. gamma-Glu-Val id157, N-phenylacetylglutamic acid id307, isovalerylglutamic acid id368, N-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)glutamine id303, guanidinosuccinic acid id153) were deliberately excluded as distinct molecules rather than the member 'detected as a form of it' -- including them would be false positives, not recall gains.

agentMatch.notes:
Scanned all 388 compounds against the 27 canonical members using InChIKey first-block (skeleton), PubChem CID, then name/synonym/stereo judgement.

CONFIDENT MATCHES (6):
- id 22 Histidine = L-Histidine: exact full InChIKey HNDVDQJCIGZPNO-YFKPBYRVSA-N + CID 6274. High.
- id 26 L-Glutamate and id 27 L-Glutamic acid = L-Glutamic acid: exact InChIKey WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-VKHMYHEASA-N + CID 33032 (both are duplicate detections of the same member). High.
- id 18 DL-Glutamic acid = L-Glutamic acid: same skeleton WHUUTDBJXJRKMK, racemic (UHFFFAOYSA) so stereochemistry not resolved; the L-form is present in the racemate. Marked stereo/parent but high confidence it represents the member.
- id 113 alpha-Ketoglutaric acid = 2-Oxoglutaric acid (alpha-ketoglutarate): exact InChIKey KPGXRSRHYNQIFN-UHFFFAOYSA-N + CID 51. High.
- id 16 D-Pantothenic acid = Pantothenic acid (vitamin B5): skeleton GHOKWGTUZJEAQD matches; canonical member lists CID 988 but the natural/biological vitamer is the D-enantiomer (CID 6613). Same molecule for pathway purposes. High.

DELIBERATE NON-MATCHES (close but excluded, to avoid false positives):
- id 60 L-Pyroglutamic acid/5-oxoproline (ODHCTXKNWHHXJC): cyclized derivative of glutamate, a distinct compound, not a listed member.
- id 151 Glutamine (ZDXPYRJPNDTMRX): amide of glutamate; different skeleton; not a member.
- id 9 Asparagine (DCXYFEDJOCDNAF): amide of aspartate; the member is L-Aspartic acid (CKLJMWTZIZZHCS) which is NOT present.
- id 58 GABA (BTCSSZJGUNDROE): C4 4-aminobutyrate, the homolog of beta-alanine (C3, UCMIRNVEIXFBKS) — different skeleton, not beta-alanine.
- id 96 2-Aminobutanoic acid, id 6/5 adenosine/adenine, id 134 Cytidine, id 141 Dihydrouridine, id 385 thymine glycol, id 244 Barbituric acid: pyrimidine/purine-adjacent but none is Uracil (ISAKRJDGNUQOIC) or Dihydrouracil (OIVLITBTBDPEFK).
- id 18/26/27 are the only glutamate hits.

MEMBERS WITH NO MATCH IN THE 388: Beta-Alanine, 3-Aminopropanal, Malonic acid semialdehyde, N-Carbamoyl-beta-alanine, Dihydrouracil, Uracil, Carnosine, Anserine, 3-Methyl-L-histidine, L-Aspartic acid, 1,3-Diaminopropane, Acetyl-CoA, Malonyl-CoA, NAD+, NADH, NADP+, NADPH, Water, Oxygen, Carbon dioxide, Ammonia, Hydrogen peroxide, Hydrogen ion. (The ubiquitous cofactors/small inorganics and CoA thioesters simply are not in this plant-metabolite detection list.)

agentMatch.notes:
Scanned all 388 compounds by InChIKey first-block (skeleton), full InChIKey, PubChem CID, and name/synonym substrings (aspart, asparag, arginin, citrull, glutam, fumar, succin, malon, oxalacet, oxoglutar/ketoglutar, alanine, acetic acid, CoA, adenyl, AMP, carbamoyl, phosphate, pyrophosph, ammonia). 7 genuine matches found.

High-confidence exact matches (full InChIKey identity): id 9 (L-Asparagine, CID 6267 = canonical), id 26 & 27 (L-Glutamic acid, WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-VKHMYHEASA-N, CID 33032 = canonical), id 113 (alpha-ketoglutarate = canonical Oxoglutaric acid, CID 51 = canonical), id 151 (L-Glutamine, CID 5961 = canonical). id 8 Arginine: file InChIKey ODKSFYDXXFIFQN-BYPYZUCNSA-N is identical to canonical L-Arginine InChIKey; CID differs (6322 free base vs canonical 28782) but it is the same compound -> high, inchikey.

Lower confidence: id 18 DL-Glutamic acid (WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-UHFFFAOYSA-N, racemate, CID 611) shares the L-Glutamic acid skeleton and contains L-glutamate; marked stereo/parent, medium.

Deliberately EXCLUDED (distinct compounds, not the member nor a detected form of it): id 60 L-Pyroglutamic acid/5-oxoproline (cyclized, different skeleton ODHCTXKNWHHXJC); ids 157, 200, 303, 304, 307, 368 glutamyl/glutamic conjugates and peptides (gamma-glutamyl-valine, gamma-glutamyl-alanine derivative, N-aryl/N-acyl glutamines and glutamates, isovalerylglutamic acid) -- all have distinct skeletons and are substituted derivatives, not free L-Glu/L-Gln; id 267 Diroximel fumarate (fumarate diester prodrug, not free fumaric acid); id 153 Guanidinosuccinic acid and id 194 Succinylacetone (not pathway members despite succin- substring); ids 86/342/344 organophosphate esters (not inorganic phosphate); id 5 Adenine and id 6 Adenosine (free base/nucleoside, not the phosphorylated AMP member). No free L-/D-aspartic acid, N-acetylaspartate, ureidosuccinate, adenylosuccinate, argininosuccinate, citrulline, beta-alanine, malonic semialdehyde, oxaloacetate, fumaric acid, acetic acid, acetyl-CoA, CoA, AMP/ATP/GDP/GTP/IMP, carbamoyl phosphate, inorganic phosphate/pyrophosphate, ammonia, CO2, water, O2, or H2O2 were detected in the 388-compound set. 14 of the 388 entries lack InChIKey/CID (ids 33, 211, 234, 235, 370, 374-382); none of their names/formulas correspond to any aspartate-metabolism member.

- Glutamate/glutamine family is the only well-populated overlap. id 27 (L-Glutamic acid) and id 26 (L-Glutamate, the conjugate-base name) both carry exact full InChIKey WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-VKHMYHEASA-N and CID 33032 = canonical member L-Glutamic acid -> high. id 151 (Glutamine) carries exact InChIKey ZDXPYRJPNDTMRX-VKHMYHEASA-N and CID 5961 = canonical L-Glutamine -> high.
- id 18 (DL-Glutamic acid, CID 611, WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-UHFFFAOYSA-N): same skeleton, racemate that contains the L-enantiomer member -> stereo/parent, medium.
- id 371 (N-Acetylglucosaminitol, CID 165206, skeleton DWAICOVNOFPYLS): the open-chain reduced alditol of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine. Different skeleton from GlcNAc (OVRNDRQMDRJTHS), so it is a reduction product / close parent rather than the ring sugar itself -> stereo/parent, low. Borderline; included to avoid under-counting per instructions. A strict skeleton-only deterministic matcher would likely MISS this one.

REJECTED near-misses (flagged for transparency):
- id 60 L-Pyroglutamic acid/5-oxoproline (ODHCTXKNWHHXJC): cyclized glutamate, distinct KEGG compound, not a listed member.
- ids 157, 200, 303, 304, 307, 368: gamma-glutamyl peptides / N-substituted or conjugated glutamic-acid derivatives, not free glutamate/glutamine.
- id 134 Cytidine, id 141 Dihydrouridine: nucleosides, not CTP/UTP/UDP or CMP-Neu5Ac.
- ids 86, 342, 344: organophosphate esters, not inorganic phosphate or pyrophosphate.
- ids 215, 224, 386, and other 'acet*' hits: acetyl/acetate-bearing larger molecules, not free acetic acid or acetyl-CoA.
- ids 15, 21 (glucose): hexose, but neither beta-D-fructose, fructose-6-P, nor an amino sugar.

ABSENT members: the ubiquitous small-molecule cofactors/substrates of this pathway (acetic acid, ammonia, water, phosphate, pyrophosphate, PEP, pyruvate, ATP, ADP, UDP, UTP, CTP, acetyl-CoA) and ALL of the defining amino sugars (D-glucosamine, glucosamine-6-P, GlcNAc and its 1-P/6-P forms, ManNAc/ManNAc-6-P, UDP-GlcNAc, Neu5Ac, Neu5Ac-9-P, CMP-Neu5Ac, chitobiose derivatives, fructose-6-P, beta-D-fructose) are genuinely not present in this elderberry metabolome export (no skeleton, CID, or synonym hits). Method: matched all 388 compounds (file /Users/bytedance/lit-synth-mvp/pathway-mapping/compounds-388.json) against the 51 canonical members by InChIKey first-block (skeleton), full InChIKey, PubChem CID, and name/synonym, with chemical judgement for stereoisomers/parents. 8 genuine matches found.

Stereo/parent (high): id18 DL-Glutamic acid (WHUUTDBJXJRKMK-UHFFFAOYSA-N, racemic) shares the L-Glutamic acid skeleton; the racemate contains the L-enantiomer member.

Borderline cases deliberately EXCLUDED as distinct molecules (different skeletons; a deterministic skeleton/CID matcher would not hit them, and they are not 'the detected form of' the member): id60 L-Pyroglutamic acid/5-oxoproline (ODHCTXKNWHHXJC) is the cyclized lactam, not free glutamate; id96 2-Aminobutanoic acid (QWCKQJZIFLGMSD) is the amino, not the 2-oxobutanoic-acid member; id127 Choline (OEYIOHPDSNJKLS) is the precursor, not Betaine; id105 4-Guanidinobutyric acid (TUHVEAJXIMEOSA) is a homolog, not Guanidinoacetic acid; glutamate conjugates id303/304/307/368 and glycine conjugates id193 (suberylglycine)/id289 (isovalerylglycine) are N-acyl/peptide derivatives, not the free members. No free Glycine, L-Alanine, L-Cysteine, Sarcosine, Creatine, Betaine, pyruvate, or any cofactor (CoA/NAD/ATP/THF/water/CO2/phosphate) appears in the 388. The 14 compounds lacking InChIKeys (id33,211,234,235,370,374-382) have no name/synonym match to any pathway member.

Scanned all 388 compounds by InChIKey first-block (skeleton), PubChem CID, and name/synonym. Exactly 3 genuine matches, each confirmed by BOTH full-stereo InChIKey AND PubChem CID identity to the canonical member: id 6 Adenosine (member Adenosine, CID 60961), id 32 "Methionine" (member L-Methionine; identical InChIKey FFEARJCKVFRZRR-BYPYZUCNSA-N and CID 6137, i.e. it is L-Met), id 127 Choline (member Choline, CID 305).

Near-misses considered and deliberately REJECTED (distinct compounds, not the detected form of any member):
- id 154 "H-Met(O)-OH" = L-methionine sulfoxide (skeleton QEFRNWWLZKMPFJ): an oxidation product with a different skeleton, not methionine.
- id 249 "Carnitine" / id 268 "DL-Carnitine" (skeleton PHIQHXFUZVPYII): carnitine, not choline (choline skeleton is OEYIOHPDSNJKLS).
- id 128 "Choline Alfoscerate" = sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (skeleton SUHOQUVVVLNYQR): a choline-containing ester, but a distinct molecule, not free choline.

Absent from the 388 (no match at any tier): Betaine, Betaine aldehyde, N,N-Dimethylglycine, L-Homocysteine, S-Adenosylmethionine, S-Adenosylhomocysteine, NAD, NADH, ATP, Coenzyme Q1, 5-Methyltetrahydrofolate, Tetrahydrofolate, Pyrophosphate, Phosphate, and Water. (Note: the dataset has no inorganic small molecules like water/phosphate/pyrophosphate, and no nucleotide cofactors.) A deterministic skeleton+CID pass returned the same 3 hits, so no recall misses are expected.
